text: Integers · 8. Jenny is on – 280 points. What score on the next hand would see her lose the game?
calculatorModeOrigin: Practice allocation; source does not state a calculator mode
originalYearOrigin: Year 8 shown on supplied marking key; test header year is blank
answerHtml:
Answer and method

The instructions say the total must fall below −500 to lose. Starting at −280, any next-hand score below −220 causes a loss (for integer scores, −221 or less). The supplied answer −220 reaches exactly −500 and does not satisfy “below”.
